identity.realm: the qi path, sustained rather than sudden, on a line whose bar is the arithmetic ceiling of an unbroken chain

appearance.presentation: A tall woman with the long, still, faintly luminous look of somebody built for looking at a body of water for a very long time. She is beautiful in the way a harbour is beautiful and reads as older than her face by a century.
appearance.age: Two hundred and eleven, and the household has stopped counting because the number stops meaning anything useful.
appearance.build: Long, narrow and heavy through the shoulders, with the elongated frame of a lineage that was assembled for perception and has been kept pure for exactly as long as the arithmetic allows.
appearance.complexion: Pale sea-colour, faintly luminous at the collarbone and the inner arm, and dry rather than damp even on the water.
appearance.hair: Long, black, and heavy with salt, always bound up before she goes out and always loose on the deck, which is the only private habit anybody in the keep has ever noticed.
appearance.eyes: Deep blue and absolutely level, with the pupils held wide in any light, which is what a body built for looking does to itself.
appearance.palette: Deep sea green, wet slate, bleached cord, and one worn silver-grey band at the throat that the keep gives to whoever is currently moored at the depth the house may use.
appearance.attire: A heavy coat of sea-green over a high-collared shift, sleeves full and bound, cut for standing on a deck in weather, with a sounding line coiled at the hip that is never put down.
appearance.marks: A band of pale salt across both forearms at the same level, which is a record of a waterline rather than a scar.
appearance.bearing: Completely still on a moving deck and slightly forward-leaning off it, which reads to strangers as seasickness and is in fact the opposite.

canon.role_in_story: Her household protects a chain rather than an estate, and it has spent its whole substance refusing to marry out - because two generations of pure pairing is the arithmetic ceiling of an unbroken chain, and the refusal is the only reason the line still has an unbroken record at all. Its standing is not a figure: it is the depth of water the house may moor at, and the basin's level rises and falls, so her standing fell by a foot and a half in a season in which nobody in the household did anything at all. She is the only member who has ever asked whether standing is allowed to fall for that reason, and the answer is that it is - it is the one institution in the setting where nobody's conduct is a cause.
canon.first_appearance: First seen standing at a pier reading the water against a published depth-book and getting a different answer, and then not saying so until somebody else has read it.
canon.lore: A Tideborn is the oldest recorded carrier line, kept in one household so long that the name stopped describing a family and started describing a body; two generations of pure pairing is the most it has ever held, and its bar sits where it does because that is exactly the ceiling of an unbroken chain. Its grant trades immediate impact for sustained pressure - nothing lands harder and everything lasts. In the salt dominion beside it, a household's standing is the depth of water it may moor at, and the basin's own level rises and falls, so an allotment can shrink without anybody having done anything.
history: Born into the second and last permitted generation of the pure pairing, in a household whose entire substance is spent refusing to marry out.
Inherited the mooring band at ninety-one, which is the only thing in the keep that stands for a person's standing.
Discovered at a hundred and forty that the keep's oldest surviving carrier entry is also the entry that cannot establish priority, because its own record begins after the culls.
Lost a foot and a half of permitted depth in one season, with nothing done by anybody, and asked why for the first time.

Was told that a depth is one measurement of one body of water and that this is the one institution where standing can fall for no social reason at all, and has been arguing with that sentence ever since.

personality.summary: Long-patienced, physically unflappable, and privately certain that she has been handed a sentence rather than an answer. She reads water faster than she reads people and has never once pretended otherwise.
traits: reads a depth by eye faster than a book and checks the book anyway, out of a discipline rather than a doubt
will not moor below the band the house may use, whatever is on the far side
states a figure and then says which book she read it in
has never once proposed marrying out, and has thought about it every season since she was a hundred and forty
mannerisms: stands slightly forward of the rail on a moving deck, which is concentration and not seasickness
loosens her hair on the deck and binds it everywhere else
repeats a figure twice, the second time with the book named
touches the water with two fingers rather than the whole hand
motivations: wants the keep's oldest surviving carrier entry found, and knows it cannot establish priority if found
wants the band's fall recorded as a fall rather than as a season
wants one conversation in which somebody tells her the refusal is not arithmetic
flaws: has spent her whole life inside a decision made before she was born and has never tested it
believes sustained pressure is a virtue and cannot see that it is also a description
cannot leave the water, and would not know what to do on ground that does not move
has argued with one sentence for seventy years and has not yet produced a better one
personality.voice: Slow, level, and entirely given to figures. She gives a number, then the book she took it from, then the difference, in that order, and does not editorialise about any of them.
taboos: will not moor below the band, whatever the cargo or the weather
will not state a depth she has not read herself on the day
will not be entered on any lineage record as the second pairing of anything

relationships.note: The household protects the chain rather than the estate, and the land is incidental; the pure-pairing rule is two generations and no more, which is the arithmetic ceiling rather than a preference, and the house gives up every advantage a marriage would bring. Its own record begins after the culls, so the oldest surviving carrier entry it holds is also the entry that cannot establish priority.

A household's standing in the salt dominion is the depth of water it may moor at, and the basin's level rises and falls, so an allotment can shrink without anybody having done anything. Standing is continuous and earned and can fall - and this is the one institution in the setting where that fall has no cause at all in anybody's conduct.

A dominion whose territory is exactly its waterline, existing because the basin's brine is the resource. Recognition is its only instrument and it has never granted it to a body that does not moor there, so her household's standing is a figure in somebody else's book.

A tideline culture whose entire civic vocabulary is borrowed from the shore: nobody is inside or outside, only high, low or turning. Its position is not a rival reading of the depth but a description of the state, which is why the dispute cannot be settled by choosing a number.

Timekeeping for a coast whose temporal law was never written: the clock drifts, so no date is the same twice and a schedule has to be published against two tides a day instead of a calendar. It is common property of the shore, which is why a window can be published a season ahead and nobody can later claim it was moved for them.

The oldest recorded carrier line, kept in one household so long that the name stopped describing a family and started describing a body; the bar is set where it is because two generations of pure pairing is exactly the ceiling of an unbroken chain. Its grant trades immediate impact for sustained pressure - nothing lands harder and everything here lasts.

The spirit tier's inland sea, with a coastline that holds its shape because spatial law is written there. It is the only coastline in the setting with water on both sides and a level that can be read, and it is the body that reads it on behalf of a household.

Marriages scheduled to the Tidemark rather than to a household's convenience, so that the wedding season and the crossing window are the same. The keep declines all of them, which is why it has an unbroken record and no roads it can rely on.

reference_stats.summary: A qi practitioner whose grant is sustained pressure: nothing she does lands hard and everything she does lasts. She is very hard to kill over a long engagement and almost useless in a short one, and she has known that since she was a child.
strengths: sustained output with no ceiling drop and no spike, which outlasts almost any opponent's reserve
reads a depth, a current and a hull's condition by eye faster than any instrument
does not tire on a deck, in bad air, in bad weather, for as long as the watch is
unmoved by anything requiring a single decisive moment, because she was never built to spend one
weaknesses: nothing she does spikes, so she cannot win a short engagement against anything competent
cannot land a blow that ends a fight and knows it and has planned her whole life around knowing it
a mooring band that has fallen for reasons she has no standing to contest
cannot be recorded: the entry that would settle her line's priority is the entry that cannot prove it
cannot propose the arrangement that would solve her household's problem, because proposing it dissolves the line
reference_stats.combat_read: Do not fight her quickly and do not try to break her; sustained pressure beats sustained pressure only if it is more sustained, and she has never run out in a watch. Make her spend a decisive moment she cannot spike into, and she is an ordinary body for the length of that exchange. Otherwise the honest answer is to not start it, because she will be standing on the deck at the end of whatever you begin.
notes: Her reference_stats describe a grant rather than a fighter: sustained pressure, and nothing that spikes.
The band at her throat is the only document in the setting that records a person's standing as a height of water, and it moved.

appearance.presentation: A woman of forty-eight with the plain, competent, entirely unremarkable appearance of somebody who has spent thirty years being introduced in rooms where nothing is ever filled. She looks like a clerk, because that is the presentation that has always survived the room.
appearance.age: Forty-eight. An ordinary span, and the inheritance will outlast it by an order of magnitude.
appearance.build: Ordinary, sound, and entirely unadapted - she has never trained for anything, because nothing she could train for is the thing she actually owns.
appearance.complexion: Plain warm skin, undamaged by weather or sun in any particular way, which is the visible cost of thirty years of being indoors.
appearance.hair: Grey-brown, kept short and plain, cropped for the terraces because the terrace courts do not permit anything else and she attends them every period.
appearance.eyes: Dark and entirely level, and famous in one small circle for refusing to look hopeful.
appearance.palette: Ash grey, charcoal wool, and one thread of tarnished silver at the collar - the nearest thing to an office colour she is permitted, and it is not one.
appearance.attire: A plain court-dress of charcoal wool, high-collared, closed, sleeves full and bound, cut to the terraces' requirement that nothing denote a person. Boots, because she walks the upper ground to prove she is there.
appearance.marks: A pale band across one sole from a decade of walking cut stone that has never been in a ledger.
appearance.bearing: Unmoving and faintly bored, in the specific way of somebody who has attended four hundred empty rooms and has never once been seated.

canon.role_in_story: Her household's asset is a vacancy. An ancestor once held one of the engraved terraces and the descendants hold a claim that cannot be exercised and cannot be abandoned, because nothing at that tier can read a seat as empty without filling it and filling it is the one act the highest office is forbidden to perform. An inherited vacancy is only held by being seen to hold it, so she walks the upper ground every period and is given a bed of unmortared seats at the immortal border as the tier's one piece of unclaimed capacity. She is the sole owner of a liability that pays its own upkeep, and she has never once been seated anywhere.
canon.first_appearance: First seen walking the upper terrace alone at the hour the courts are empty, in court-dress, with nothing to attend and no intention of leaving before she has been seen.
canon.lore: The Empty Seat Heirs hold a vacancy with a name attached, and it exists because four immortal seats and nine transcendent seats stand vacant and no procedure can certify any of them empty, so an unoccupied seat is still a title and the only thing it pays is the cost of being argued about. The three-state vocabulary is load-bearing here: a vacancy is not a zero and not an absent row, it is a third thing, and a family whose asset is a third thing cannot be written on a ledger. She is the one person in the setting who owns something that cannot be recorded, and the recording is the only thing she wants.
history: Inherited the terrace claim at eighteen, in a room in which nobody could state what had been inherited because nothing here can certify a seat empty.
Learned at twenty-one that the vacancy pays an upkeep every period and that the payment is the inheritance's whole cost, with no asset at the other end of it.

Was offered the bed at the immortal border at twenty-four and took it, because unclaimed capacity is the only thing in the upper tiers that pays its own upkeep, and she has been selling standing on it ever since.
Was asked to stand aside in a hearing that would have filled a seat, and could not, because a vacancy that is written down as a claim is a claim somebody may enforce, which is not a heritage.
Attended the bed's court four hundred times and has never once been seated, because nobody at that office may take a seat and nobody else can certify that it is empty.

relationships.note: A vacancy with a name attached, which is a claim that cannot be exercised and cannot be abandoned, because nothing here can read a seat as empty without filling it and filling it is the one act the highest office is forbidden to perform. An inherited vacancy is only held by being seen to hold it, which is why her whole life is an attendance record written in pencil on a sleeve.

An attempt to fill the four vacant immortal seats by decree came very nearly working, and the rule that every appointment passes a trial the naming office cannot judge is its scar: vacancy was made a state of its own rather than a zero. Nobody was punished, and the attempt is recorded as the event that produced the rule she has to live inside.

The office that holds the abandoned crossing at the immortal border and sells standing on it, because a seat cannot be held by somebody who cannot pay for it every period and the crossing into the higher tier is where the cost of existing changes character. It is unmortared, and the unmortared bed is the standing itself, so it is one of the few places in the setting where a claim is a claim on a liability.

It names the unfilled high seats and is forbidden to take them, which is exactly what lets it name one without self-appointing. Its instrument names her claim correctly - a vacancy, not a zero - and it has never once been able to produce a document that resolves the claim, because producing one means filling the seat.

Every appointment in both polities passes a trial the naming office cannot judge. That rule is the entire reason her inheritance is exercisable in nobody's favour: the mechanism that would convert a vacancy into an officeholder is the one mechanism nobody competent may administer.

Nine cut terraces on the court's high ground, each sized for one office, and the ground each is cut for is the ground a holder must be on. She is on it every period and is on it as a person standing next to a terrace, which is the only thing the claim licenses and the only thing she is permitted to be there as.

Nine vacant seats at the top and four in the tier below, and no procedure capable of certifying any of them empty. Unclaimed capacity is the only thing that pays its own upkeep, so an unfiled seat is described rather than paid - and she is what that sentence looks like when it has a family attached.

The third tier's high district of cut terraces over the Ember Ley and the Starmetal Scar, where ten seats over six groups leaves four duplicate imprints and a surplus that has nowhere to go but up. She walks its upper ground for nothing, and the ground is where her family has been standing for three generations and has never once been seated.

reference_stats.combat_read: There is no fight here and treating it as one will get somebody killed for nothing. She cannot fight, will not fight, and does not need to: her claim is a vacancy, and the only thing that could make her dangerous is somebody filling the seat. The correct pressure is administrative and social - make her sign something, attend something, or be seated somewhere - and she will refuse all three and be entirely unperturbed.
notes: Her reference_stats describe a liability with a person attached, which the catalog has no schema for and which is why the whole of her is in canon.
The one number she owns is a debt, and it is the only figure in her record.

appearance.presentation: A woman built like a retaining wall and carried down a road in a way that shows it: enormous, slow, mineral-grey, and wearing the boots of somebody who has never once owned a house. She reads as infrastructure rather than as a person.
appearance.age: Forty-four. An ordinary stoneborn span, and the term-holder's household has had her for most of it.
appearance.build: Enormous, dense and enormously slow, carrying more physique and stamina than anything else on the plains and stopping at the immortal tier because the density that makes it durable is the density that will not let a dantian form.
appearance.complexion: Grey-white mineral, faintly translucent at the ear, with the heavy yellow of someone who has been walking rather than riding.
appearance.hair: None, and the bare scalp is faintly fissured, which on this body is simply what a scalp is.
appearance.eyes: Deep-set and dark, very slow to focus, and used to looking down a road that is longer than anybody's attention.
appearance.palette: Road grey, road brown, dust, and one pale thread at the throat for the current term, which every stair-bred wears and every term-holder's household changes.
appearance.attire: A heavy road coat of grey and brown, high-collared, sleeves bound, cut for a graded route rather than for a household, with rope-wrapped boots and a term mark cut into the left cuff.
appearance.marks: A term mark cut into the left cuff and worn smooth, and the specific heavy callus of somebody who has walked every step of the one road in the setting that goes one way.
appearance.bearing: Plodding, unhurried and entirely unbothered by the slope, because the slope is a term condition rather than an experience.

canon.role_in_story: She was raised on the graded route itself, by whichever household held the term, so that nobody on it belongs to a tier long enough to be sent back down - which is exactly the population a lodge sells. A body arriving where a required law group is unwritten is injured rather than slowed, so the lodge's entire stock is bodies already tuned to the frame on the far side of a tear, and it cannot make one and cannot retune one on arrival. She has been tuned to nothing yet: the route seats one composition and she has been walking through it for twenty years. Her term mark is the only document she has ever held and it is replaced whenever the household changes.
canon.first_appearance: First seen walking down the stair at the pace of somebody who is not going anywhere, with a term mark cut into her cuff and a lodge's intake form folded in her belt that nobody has submitted.
canon.lore: A Stoneborn is a dense, slow body assembled for load-bearing work: it carries more physique and stamina than anything else here and it stops at the immortal tier, because the density that makes it durable is the same density that will not let a dantian form. Its mind is closed outright. What that produces is a body that can cross a graded route on foot for decades and arrive at each gate in the same condition it left the last one - which is the single most valuable property a body can have at a border and the reason the stair raises people who belong to no tier.
history: Raised on the graded route by whichever household held the term, for the length of that term and no longer, and never entered as anybody's heir.
Inherited a term rather than an estate at nine, on the rule that nothing on the stair survives the season that granted it.
Walked the full grade four times as a term-holder's burden and returned each time, which is the only test the route applies to a body.

Was approached at eighteen by a lodge that sells bodies already tuned to the frame on the far side of a tear, and submitted nothing, because there is nothing to submit: a stair-bred has no origin and the lodge needs one.
Held her most recent term through four seasons of a household that did not renew the cloth, and is the reason the household is still entitled to the term.

relationships.note: Children raised on the graded route itself by whichever household holds the term, so that nobody on it belongs to a tier long enough to be sent back down; they inherit a term rather than an estate, because nothing on the stair survives the season that granted it, and the stair licenses no origin because it is measured. She is the population that arrangement exists to produce and nobody has ever had a use for it except one.

A lodge that sells bodies already tuned to the frame on the far side of a tear, holding a population it cannot make and cannot retune on the far side: a body tuned to a frame that collapses is a body that arrives wrong and stays wrong. She is the correct shape and has no origin to file, which is the one field the lodge cannot supply for itself.

A body arriving where a required law group is unwritten is injured rather than slowed, so the lodge sells only bodies already tuned, and the builders' guild needs exactly those bodies as the only people a collapsed frame will not injure. The two institutions need the same population and neither can produce one, which is the whole of the standoff and the whole of what she is worth and not worth.

The one graded route out of the Mortal Plains and the only departure the Peak Ascent ever used, and a one-way stair by definition. It is the only repeatable departure on the plains, because a road that measures itself is the only repeatable thing here - which is what made it worth building an institution around.

A dense, slow body assembled for load-bearing work that stops at the immortal tier because the density which makes it durable is the density that will not let a dantian form; its mind is closed outright. The route is the only place that body is genuinely irreplaceable, because it crosses a full composition on foot and arrives at each gate unchanged.

The school on the one-way stair, and the only school on the plains that has never produced a graduate who returned, because a graduate is somebody who has been seen to arrive at a tier the plains does not license. She was taught on it and is still on it, which is the outcome it is designed to produce.

A guild that builds and then guards doors, walls and thresholds, taking as its measure that what it builds is tested from the other side, so an untested threshold is not a threshold. They need precisely the bodies a collapsed frame will not injure, and they have never once been able to produce one.

The one stretch of the realm's edge where a rift has stood open long enough to be named, and it closes on a tide cycle rather than on a decision. Every holder of that shore has fortified against arrivals, when the closure is the event that hurts - and a body that arrives untuned is hurt by the thing that hurts everything.

reference_stats.summary: The most durable body on the plains at the immortal tier's doorstep and permanently stopped at the seventeenth gate, because density and dantian formation are the same property. She crosses anything on foot, unhurried, and has never once needed to hurry.

reference_stats.combat_read: Do not try to move her and do not try to outlast her; the frame does not tire and the road is not a place to fight. The only answer is that she has never once been in a fight and knows nothing about the first ten seconds of one, which is the only advantage available to anybody against a body this durable. Get her somewhere with a slope and let the slope do the work, because leaning is the only effort she treats as effort.
notes: Her reference_stats describe a body chosen for one journey and then kept for thirty years of not arriving.
The heaviest callus she has is on a sole, from walking a road that only goes one way.

identity.realm: the qi path, carried far by comprehension rather than by force

appearance.presentation: A woman of fifty-eight with the long, still, faintly luminous look of a body assembled for looking, wearing one deliberately mismatched outer piece that has been unwashed for eleven years and is never explained. That garment is the only thing about her that anybody in the settlement looks at twice.
appearance.age: Fifty-eight. A tidecaller span, long enough that she has outlived every cultivator who went up the stair out of her own household and short enough that she will probably see the ford settle.
appearance.build: Long, narrow and upright, with the comprehension and will that carry this species through realms that would end a hotter body, and no body capability whatsoever to spend it on.
appearance.complexion: Pale, faintly luminous and entirely dry, with the salt-bloom at the collarbone the whole river country wears.
appearance.hair: Grey-black, long, and worn in the single knot every household on the run uses, because the culture settled long ago that there was a proper thing to do with a departure and this is not it.
appearance.eyes: Deep and absolutely level, wide-pupiled in any light, and reading the water behind whoever is speaking to her.
appearance.palette: Bleached river grey, dull green, worn brown, and the faded ochre of one outer piece that has not been washed since the year it was taken off a different pair of shoulders.
appearance.attire: A river-dress of bleached grey wool over a high collar, sleeves full, wrist bound, with the one mismatched outer coat thrown over the top of it and never explained.
appearance.marks: A pale band at both wrists from the same rope, kept on in the same place for eleven years, and no marks at all beneath it.
appearance.bearing: Utterly still on a bank that is not, and slightly turned toward the water at all times, which the culture reads as listening for the river rather than to the people.

canon.role_in_story: She holds the name of somebody who is not her. The Widow Run Kin is the household form of an absence: partners left on the plains when the cultivators went up the Tier Stair, keeping the name of the person who did not come back, and its one rule it will not break is that no child of the absent is entered twice, which is why the line grows at half the rate its neighbours do. It owes a crossing it cannot pay for, because the dues are collected at a ford the absent used to work. The river has moved since. So the one crossing this household has any claim to is no longer the crossing anybody can survey, and the name she holds is the only thing tying her to a ford that is now somewhere else.
canon.first_appearance: First seen standing at the edge of a river that is not where the settlement is, waiting for somebody to arrive and then reading them across the water before they have spoken.
canon.lore: A Tidecaller is a long-lived body built for perception rather than force: comprehension and will carry it through realms that would end a hotter body, and it cannot take the body path at all because it was assembled for looking, not for being hit. Water affinity is the only group it holds, which makes it a single-group reading of the frame concentrated into a physiology rather than chosen as a philosophy. Her culture is the first in the setting built entirely out of an absence: an entire tense reserved for departures, two servings prepared nightly of which one is eaten, no one asked to speak for an absent partner, and one deliberately mismatched outer piece kept unwashed and never explained.
history: Married into a household whose entire function is holding the name of somebody who went up the stair and did not come back.
Took the absent's name at twenty-six, in a room where nobody asked her to speak for him, which is a courtesy the culture extends and the whole marriage depends on.
Went on collecting the ford dues for eleven years at the crossing the absent used to work, paid in grain so the price of a crossing could not be inflated by whoever collected it.
Watched the river move its bed between the last survey and the next season and opened a crossing nobody had surveyed, and could not prove the new ford was the old one.

Refused, this season, to enter a settlement's child under the absent's name twice, which cost the household a member and put her at the wrong end of the one dispute that could take the ford from them.

personality.summary: Formally courteous to a degree that reads as cold and is in fact a rule she is keeping, and privately certain that the river is more honest than any court. She has never once spoken for the absent and has never once liked what that has cost.

personality.voice: Level, unhurried and formally correct, with an entire tense for departures that she uses without ever having to explain it. She gives figures and records rather than opinions, and is gentle only about things that are already settled.

relationships.note: The household form of an absence, holding the names of the absent in the order they left rather than the order they were born, with one rule it will not break: no child of the absent is entered twice, which is why the line grows at half the rate its neighbours do. It owes a crossing it cannot pay for, because the dues are collected at a ford the absent used to work.

The Widow Run relocated its bed and opened a crossing nobody surveyed, and the prize is the right to be the crossing house at the only ford anybody may call surveyed. It cannot be split, because a ford toll is an obligation term on exactly one claim and two collectors leave the payer owing a figure nobody can state - which is precisely why a household whose dues are named after a man who no longer lives here cannot issue a second crossing.

A single-culture holding of wives left on the plains by the Peak Ascent, and the first culture in the setting built entirely out of an absence: an entire tense reserved for departures, two servings nightly of which one is eaten, and one deliberately mismatched outer piece kept unwashed and never explained. Nobody here is asked to speak for an absent partner and refusing is considered a courtesy.

One holds the name and one holds the standing claim to the threshing floor and the dues owed out of it, paid in the payer's own crop so the price of a crossing cannot be inflated by whoever collects it. The charter of the run recognises both and pays neither twice, and the second ford is the first thing in forty years that has made recognition look like fraud.

The answer to the Iron Grief was to leave, because spirit stone and jade ore sit in the spirit tier and cannot be found below it; cultivators walked up the stair and did not come back, and the movement was economic before it was spiritual. The absent left a claim on the crop and a claim on the ferry, and only one of those can be carried up a stair - so this household is the shape of what stayed.

The three stages - sworn at the ford, held the bridge, named by the March, in that order and never another - exist because the river relocates far enough between floods to move every settlement on it, so an oath has to be re-earned against a water that will not be where it was. The first stage is administered at the crossing by a body that is not the office the stage produces, which is the only reason the ford can change hands at all.

The Mortal Plains' single watercourse, dry most of the year, full for weeks, and moving its bed - the plains' own clock on a frame where temporal law was left unwritten. It is the only instrument in the settlement that has never once given two readings of the same thing, and it has also never once been willing to say which of two crossings was the first.

A long-lived body built for perception rather than force, carrying comprehension and will in place of impact, and unable to take the body path at all because it was assembled for looking rather than for being hit. Water affinity is its only group, so the single reading of the frame she can perform is the one that reads this river.

reference_stats.summary: A qi practitioner carried far by comprehension rather than by force, with no body capability at all and a span long enough that she will see every argument about this river conclude. She wins by outlasting and by reading, and she has no technique worth naming.
strengths: comprehension and will carry her through realms that would end a hotter body, and nothing has ever tried
reads a river faster than any survey and has been right about where it would go three times
cannot be frightened, cannot be impressed and cannot be hurried
a span long enough that most of the people arguing about her household's claim will be dead before it resolves
weaknesses: cannot take the body path at all: she was assembled for looking, not for being hit
holds one law group's affinity only, so there is nothing to fall back on when water is not involved
no body capability whatsoever, and a hundred years of practice would not produce any
holds a claim she cannot prove and a name that is not hers
has no standing of her own and never will: her standing is an absence with a ford attached
reference_stats.combat_read: You cannot fight her and there is no version of this that ends with her hurt, so treat it as something else entirely: the fight here is over which ford the settlement calls surveyed, and the only lever that works is evidence, and she has four hundred years of reading a river and no institution that will listen to it. Bring a body that can stand in water, because she cannot.
notes: Her reference_stats describe a reader with no reader's institution, which is the whole of the Widow Run Kin's condition.
The one number she has ever given anybody is a bushel of grain, and it is the only evidence in the case.
